protocol: §6.N / Seventh Law clause 5 — production-code-mutation bluff hunt over *Test.kt
agent_role: wave-8 bluff-hunt subagent (shared tree, read-only + test-only edits)
method: For each target: located the production class it claims to cover, applied a deliberate non-crashing mutation to that PRODUCTION code path (Edit, never committed), ran the test via Gradle, recorded survives/fails, then reverted the production mutation. Tests run serially (shared tree). After the hunt, all 5 production files were verified byte-identical to HEAD (git diff --quiet on core/ + feature/ returned CLEAN).
safe_module_scope: core/{auth,work,sync,preferences,models}, feature/{onboarding,provider_config,connection,bookmarks,favorites,visited,account,menu,rating}, core/tracker/{rutor,kinozal,nnmclub} parsers — avoided modules under edit this wave (feature/topic, feature/search*, core/domain search use cases, lava-api-go, core/tracker/api+client+archiveorg+gutenberg).
rotation_note: Targets chosen to NOT overlap earlier loop hunts (TopicConverterTest, EndpointEntityGoApiFieldsTest, EnrichFilterUseCaseTest, CategoryViewModelTest, RatingViewModelTest, ProbeMirrorUseCaseTest, EndpointConverterTest, LoginViewModelTest, and wave6/wave7 gate-script targets). Spans 4 architectural layers: scheduling-mapping, outbox-FIFO, HTML parser, auth-service DTO mapping, ViewModel persistence.

targets.mutation: SyncPeriod.DAY flex `6.hours` -> `6.days` (re-introduce the documented historical regression where flex 6 days > repeat 1 day, which WorkManager silently clamps to the full period — destroying the user's flex window).
targets.observed: 2 tests FAILED: `DAY sync flex is six hours, not six days` (AssertionError at SyncPeriodIntervalsTest.kt:62) and `flex interval never exceeds repeat interval for any periodic SyncPeriod` (AssertionError at SyncPeriodIntervalsTest.kt:46). 3 tests completed, 2 failed.

targets.layer: Sync outbox FIFO replay queue producer
targets.mutation: `createdAt = System.currentTimeMillis()` -> `createdAt = 0` (stop stamping a real monotonic wall-clock; the FIFO sort the consumer relies on becomes meaningless).
targets.observed: 1 test FAILED: `enqueue stamps real createdAt and observe replays in FIFO order` (AssertionError at SyncOutboxImplTest.kt:84 — `every enqueued row MUST carry a real (non-zero) createdAt timestamp`). 3 tests completed, 1 failed. Matches the rehearsal documented in the test KDoc.

targets.mutation: MB branch `(num * 1024 * 1024)` -> `(num * 1024)` (drop one 1024 factor so a 1.5 MB row is parsed as 1536 bytes instead of 1572864 — a 1024x user-visible size error).
targets.observed: 1 test FAILED: `GB MB KB B units each map to the binary multiplier` (the MB assertion). Other 4 tests (TB, comma-decimal GB, zero-byte, unrecognised-unit) PASSED — failure localized to exactly the mutated MB branch. 5 tests completed, 1 failed.

targets.mutation: `is AuthResponseDto.ServiceUnavailable -> AuthResult.ServiceUnavailable(dto.reason)` -> `AuthResult.WrongCredits(null)` (re-introduce the historical Bug-1 §6.L-57th bluff where a service outage was misreported to the user as 'Wrong credentials').
targets.observed: 1 test FAILED: `login ServiceUnavailable maps to ServiceUnavailable with the verbatim reason` (AssertionError at AuthServiceImplLoginTest.kt:141). 8 tests completed, 1 failed — failure localized to exactly the mutated branch.

targets.layer: ViewModel persistence (Robolectric + real Room in-memory DB)
targets.mutation: Revert the ToggleAnonymous handler from `providerConfigRepository.setUseAnonymous(providerId, !current)` to the pre-fix in-memory-only `reduce { state.copy(anonymous = !state.anonymous) }` (Sweep Finding #1 bluff class — toggle survives in-state but is lost across process restart).
targets.observed: 1 test FAILED: `Finding 1 - ToggleAnonymous persists across ViewModel recreation` (AssertionError). The vm2 (process-restart equivalent) never observed anonymous=true because the toggle was never persisted. 2 tests completed, 1 failed.

summary.verdict: All 5 sampled tests are GENUINE anti-bluff tests — each provably FAILED with a clear, localized assertion when its production code path was deliberately broken with a non-crashing mutation. 0 bluffs surfaced. No LVA ticket required.
